hero.title: About DocumentoIQ
hero.subtitle: DocumentoIQ was born with a vision: to transform how organisations work with complex documents, making information easier to understand, organise and use without replacing professional judgement.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.description: Simplify work with complex documents by turning information into clear, usable results that help professionals and organisations work with greater confidence and efficiency.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.description: To become a leading Document Intelligence platform, capable of evolving alongside the needs of different industries and transforming how organisations work with their information.

values.title: Our principles
values.subtitle: The ideas that guide how we build DocumentoIQ and how we understand Document Intelligence.

precision.title: Trust
precision.description: We design every experience to handle sensitive information consistently, responsibly and reliably.

speed.title: Human judgement
speed.description: Technology should assist professionals, making their work easier without replacing their knowledge or final decision.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: We aim to make Document Intelligence easy to adopt and use, without requiring advanced technical knowledge.

team.title: Our team
team.description: DocumentoIQ brings together experience in technology, development and document processes to build solutions that address real needs across different industries.

ai.title: Technology and Artificial Intelligence
ai.description: Experience in AI, document processing and technologies applied to the analysis of complex information.

legal.title: Document knowledge
legal.description: Understanding of the processes, structures and document needs specific to different industries.

development.title: Development and integration
development.description: Technical capability to build, evolve and integrate DocumentoIQ within different environments and operations.

impact.title: The impact of working smarter
impact.subtitle: DocumentoIQ helps transform document-intensive processes into tasks that are more agile, consistent and easier to manage.
impact.microcopy: Average results observed in real implementations.

differentiator.title: How we build DocumentoIQ
differentiator.subtitle: We start from real needs to develop capabilities that make working with complex information simpler and more consistent.

specialization.title: We start with the process
specialization.description: We understand the context, rules and results each workflow needs.

humanCentric.title: We design the specialisation
humanCentric.description: We define which information is relevant and how it should be presented.

multilingual.title: We apply the technology
multilingual.description: We select the capabilities needed to analyse and structure the content.

evolution.title: We continuously evolve
evolution.description: We incorporate improvements as new needs and ways of working emerge.

partnersBanner.title: Bring AI solutions to your market
partnersBanner.description: Join the DocumentoIQ partner network and develop new business opportunities around document automation and intelligence.

cta.title: Partnerships that expand our reach
cta.subtitle: We work with partners who share our vision and help us bring DocumentoIQ to new organisations, markets and industries.
